scientific_integrity: The complete relative pair list is checked at every deletion, and an independent acyclic matching identifies the remaining homotopy type. Computed mod-two homology is a secondary check, not a substitute for the integral/simple-homotopy proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the eleven-vertex Grötzsch graph. The 105 elementary collapses are nonequivariant; no general Mycielski-family or symmetry-representation theorem is asserted. Independently checked finite certificates establish each combinatorial step; unindexed bibliographic overlap remains possible.
title: An exact relative collapse for the Grötzsch two-independence complex
